verdicts.reason: A keeps a sensible left-to-right order (headline, then subline, then the Shop Now CTA), but the SOLSTICE logo has shrunk to an illegible speck at the far left over a large empty dark area. The can is now a tiny orange dot jammed under the subline, so the key product image is effectively lost. B breaks reading order: the supporting line 'Small-batch and lightly sweet.' is pushed to the far left and wrapped into three tiny lines that come before the headline. It also has no visible logo, and the can is again a meaningless speck under the headline, so its brand and hierarchy are worse than A's.
